name: How long does an accessible bathroom renovation typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does an accessible bathroom renovation typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of an accessible bathroom renovation depends on the extent of the changes. Simple upgrades like installing grab bars and replacing a toilet might take a few days. A more comprehensive renovation, involving demolition, plumbing reconfigurations, installing a roll-in shower, and widening doorways, can take anywhere from two to six weeks. Unexpected structural issues or material delays can also influence the timeline. We provide a projected schedule during the planning phase.
acceptedAnswer.description: Renovation timelines vary: a few days for minor updates, or two to six weeks for comprehensive overhauls involving major structural or plumbing changes.
